entry.name: RealDexUMI
entry.title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
entry.summary: Over 100 h of demonstrations (more than 200 episodes per task, more than eight tasks) recorded with a wearable module: an 11-DoF dexterous hand with piezoresistive fingertip arrays (20 Hz), an in-hand RGB camera (30 Hz) and a 6-DoF tracker, driven by the operator through a palm-side isomorphic glove; the dataset used in the experiments is announced.
entry.hand: RealDexUMI hand (11 DoF, 6 actuated), carried by the operator and driven through a palm-side isomorphic glove; the same module is mounted on a Franka FR3 for deployment

sensor.note: Piezoresistive tactile array on each fingertip; the policy's tactile input is 5x10x4. Maker, taxels per fingertip and units not stated. Described in the paper; no files released.

scale.text: over 100 h, more than 200 episodes per task over more than eight tasks (eight evaluated, one bimanual); not released

entry.access: Section 3.4 of the paper states the authors 'will release the collected dataset used in our experiments'; no link on the arXiv page or the project page research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi (read 2026-11-27).
caveats: Not released: the numbers come from the paper, and no file was seen.
The robot hand touches the objects; the operator's own hand is inside a palm-side glove that sends press-and-release commands, so the touch is robot-side.
Total episodes, operator count and objects are not reported; 'over 100 hours' and 'more than 200 episodes per task' are the paper's wording.
Hand, tactile sensor, camera and tracker makers are not named.

tracking.system: 6-DoF tracker rigidly mounted on the hand module (system not named)
tracking.note: gives hand-frame pose for relative-motion labels; not a policy input

tracking.system: measured joint state of the 6 actuated hand joints
tracking.note: recorded together with the glove commands
press-and-release finger inputs mapped to linear hand commands

sources: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.06033 (hardware, Table 4 rates, data scale, Section 3.4 release statement, results; v2)
unconfirmed: hours = 100 is the paper's lower bound ('over 100 hours').
tasks = 8 counts the evaluated tasks; the paper says data covers 'more than eight' tasks.
The 5x10x4 tactile input may be five fingertips with 10x4 taxels each; the paper does not say, so taxels_per_hand is left null.
Tactile 20 Hz and camera 30 Hz are the 'typical' rates in Table 4.

channels.name: fingertip tactile (per paper; no release)
channels.note: described in the paper, not checked against files

channels.name: 6-DoF tracker pose (per paper)
